Proposition
[Adjoints and skew-adjoint endomorphisms]

Source: petersen:page-0082 ↗ def:pet-ch2-endomorphism-derivation ↗ def:pet-ch2-tensor-algebra-inner-product

1. ch2:2.3.3Assume $V$ has an inner product. (1) The adjoint of $L:V\to V$ extends to the adjoint of $L:T(V)\to T(V)$. (2) If $L\in \mathfrak {so}(V)$ (skew-adjoint), then $L$ commutes with type change of tensors.
Proof

↗ def:pet-ch2-endomorphism-derivation ↗ def:pet-ch2-tensor-algebra-inner-product

\sketch In an orthonormal tensor basis the induced action is the sum of the matrix of $L$ over all slots; transposing each summand gives the induced action of $L^\dagger $. Hence $\langle LT_1,T_2\rangle =\langle T_1,L^\dagger T_2\rangle $. If $L^\dagger =-L$, the sign from moving $L$ through the metric cancels the sign attached to a covariant slot, so raising or lowering an index commutes with the induced action.

□
